mirror_plan: page-by-page 1:1 mirror plan — 19 source pages condensed to 10 slot mirrors with element-level coordinates

cover_title.treatment: LEFT-aligned (x ≈ 10% inner margin) 2-line Black weight Korean heading. Single hanja '大' enlarged to ~96pt on #FFFF00 yellow fluorescent rectangle background (rect z-order behind text, text in WHITE on yellow). Lines: y ≈ 32% '2026년,' / y ≈ 46% '한국경제 [大] 도약의 원년'.

agenda_label.treatment: Large '목 차' label with WIDE letter-spacing (2-3 char widths between 목 and 차). Anchored at x ≈ 12%, y ≈ 50%. NO yellow highlight used on agenda page (exception).

agenda_item.treatment: Bullet marker = circular dot with sky→purple gradient (#1F91DF → #5464A6). 4 agency names listed; first (기획재정부) has 2 sub-bullets indented at 17pt: 'Ⅰ. 25년 평가 및 향후 업무추진방향' / 'Ⅱ. 중점 추진과제'. Other 3 agencies are single line.

divider_title.treatment: 2-line centered (horizontal AND vertical) heading on dark navy radial spotlight background. Roman numeral 'Ⅰ.'/'Ⅱ.' ~10pt LARGER than surrounding Korean (~46pt vs ~42pt). FORBIDDEN: giant 96pt Light roman numerals, white background, dark-blue 1pt rule, English labels ('SECTION 02').

body_header_title.treatment: Inside dark navy header bar (12.8% slide height, left margin ~3%, vertically centered). Format: 'N. 한글 주제목 : 핵심키워드 + 추가텍스트'. The 1-3 keyword phrase after the colon sits on a #FFFF00 yellow fluorescent rectangle with #0D1627 black text. MANDATORY on every body page (occasionally TWO keywords as on p-09 mirror, p-12 mirror). EXCEPTIONS: p-04 mirror header has NO yellow keyword (yellow appears in body callouts instead); p-05 mirror header has NO yellow keyword (yellow appears as 'p-05의 5년 만에 최고' callout).

pill_box_header.treatment: White bold Korean text inside rounded-rectangle pill (radius 24px, aspect 3:1 to 5:1). Pill fill from 4-color brand palette: sky/teal/royal/purple. NO gradient fill. NO border.

category_badge.treatment: Black bold text on small #FFFF00 yellow or #FFD966 amber rectangle badge. Formats: '국정과제 60' / '2026 업무추진방향:' / '1월중, 관계부처 합동' / '2024 업무추진방향' (can be 2-line). Sits to the LEFT of the pill box header or at module top-left corner like a dewey number.

body_paragraph.bullet_style: Korean: ☑ (white box check) / ▪ (filled square) / - (em dash) / · (middle dot)
body_paragraph.inline_emphasis: Bold #0D1627 OR yellow #FFFF00 fluorescent rectangle background with black text (mandatory at least once per body page)

timeline_month_label.treatment: Month label sits ABOVE the gradient arrow ribbon and BELOW the drop-pin. Examples: 6월 / 7월 / 8월 / 10월 / 12월 / 12월.

timeline_callout_line1.treatment: On #FFFF00 yellow fluorescent rectangle background. Used on 3 of 6 milestones only: '대통령 주재' / '최단기' / '헌법시한내'.

timeline_callout_line2.treatment: Bold white text inside gradient arrow ribbon below line 1. Examples: 1차 비경 / 2차 추경 / 새정부 경제성장전략 / 관세협상 타결 / 세제 정상화 / '26년 예산.

subthesis_with_hanja_echo.treatment: On dark navy header bar (narrative slide 9). Format: ''26년을 "한국경제 [大] 도약 원년"으로'. '大' character is ~36pt on #FFFF00 yellow fluorescent rectangle with WHITE text (cover signature echoed in body).

page_indicator.position: footer bar right edge (x ≈ 96%, vertically centered)

chart_value_emphasis.treatment: Direct label on emphasis data point ONLY. Other points use small 11pt #A5A5A5 muted labels. NEVER tabular monospace.

chart_yellow_callout.treatment: Small yellow #FFFF00 fluorescent callout box ABOVE the chart emphasis point. Example on p-05 panel 3: '5년 만에 최고' over the 79.1 peak. Serves as the panel's yellow signature.

takeaway_below_chart.treatment: 2-line bold takeaway below chart, headline number colored in panel-matching brand color. Examples: '3분기 [1.3]% 성장 / 15분기 만에 최고' (1.3% sky), '코스피 / 사상 첫 [4,000] 돌파' (4,000 green), '소상공인 체감경기 / [5년 만에 최고수준]' (5년 만에 최고수준 purple).

closing_main_line_1.treatment: On pure BLACK #000000 background. y ≈ 25%. Format: '한국경제 [大] 도약'. '大' character is ~60pt on #FFFF00 yellow fluorescent rectangle with WHITE text — echoes cover signature, deck alpha-omega closure.

closing_submark.format:
그 이행을 위해
기획재정부, 국세청, 관세청, 조달청이 앞장서겠습니다

type.monospace_banned: IBM Plex Mono / JetBrains Mono / Courier — strictly FORBIDDEN. No tabular numerals. No uppercase tracked English wordmark labels.
type.ninety_six_pt_light_divider_banned: Giant 96pt Light roman numeral / white background / dark-blue 1pt rule / English section label divider style — strictly FORBIDDEN. Dividers use 42pt Bold centered on dark navy spotlight.

spacing.footer_page_indicator_position: right edge (x ≈ 96%), vertically centered in footer bar
spacing.agency_underline_height_px: 3-4 amber-gold #FFD966 line directly below header bar (narrative-as-agency-page mirror)
spacing.grid_columns: variable per slide kind: 2-column / 2x2 quadrant / 2x3 module / 3-panel / 6-icon ribbon / central giant shape + satellites / 5-tier horizontal stack

shape.drop_pin_shape: rounded inverted teardrop / map marker (circle on top + downward triangle merged), fill #E0E5EB with #0D1627 line-art glyph inside
shape.border: 0.5pt #D1D5DB hairline on content boxes only (optional, micro-shadow alt). Dark background shapes have no border.
shape.shadow: subtle drop shadow allowed on content boxes (offset 0,2 blur 4 alpha 0.08); memo paper has soft drop shadow (offset 0,4 blur 8 alpha 0.15); no glow effects except header bar top-left radial glow and cover/divider/closing radial spotlight
shape.emphasis_fill: 4-color brand palette pills (sky/teal/royal/purple), yellow #FFFF00 highlight rectangles, dark navy #1A223F diamond, deep blue #283473 challenge circle — never gradient on pills
shape.dotted_connector_stroke: 1px #B0B6BF dashed/dotted from numbered badge to memo paper (slide 9 narrative)
shape.cyan_concentric_arc: 1px stroke #1E3A5C at 30% opacity, 2-3 concentric arcs in 1-2 slide corners (cover / agenda / dividers / closing)

background_modes.cinematic_dark_radial_spotlight: Full #05091A dark navy + large ellipse soft radial gradient (center-bottom: center #1A2540 → outer #05091A) + 1-2 corners with 1px #1E3A5C 30% opacity concentric arc rings. Used on cover, agenda, section-divider. Closing slide uses #000000 pure black with small upper-right cyan glow streak.
background_modes.body_sandwich: Top dark navy header bar (12.8%, #0D1627 with top-left #003F7B radial glow) + middle off-white plate (80%, #F2F3F4) + bottom dark navy footer bar (7%, #0D1627). Used on all body pages (slides 4-9). Agency-page mirror (slide 10 closing-adjacent variant if rendered as body) adds 3-4px amber #FFD966 underline directly below header bar.

header_bar.top_left_glow: #003F7B radial gradient, ~40% radius, fades to black on the right
header_bar.content: white bold Korean title left-aligned (x ≈ 3%, vertically centered), format 'N. 주제목 : 핵심키워드' — keyword on yellow fluorescent rectangle with BLACK text. Can carry TWO yellow keywords (e.g. p-09 / p-12 mirror).

footer_bar.content: page indicator '-N-' in #A5A5A5 at right edge only (x ≈ 96%)
footer_bar.source_footnote: NEVER in footer — footer is page-indicator-only

chart.signature: 3-panel single-line chart row — each panel has a colored pill header (sky/teal/purple), a bracketed topic label (gray purple #5464A6 or #6B7380), a single 1.5pt monochrome polyline (panel-specific color: sky / green / purple), and a 2-line takeaway below with headline number in panel color
chart.data_encoding: panel-by-panel monochrome (one color per line). Sky #1F91DF for panel 1 (경제성장률), green #70AD47 for panel 2 (KOSPI), purple #5464A6 for panel 3 (BSI). No rainbow within a single panel.
chart.line: 1.5pt monochrome polyline; emphasis data point gets a 0.12in solid filled circle + big bold panel-color 22pt value label nearby (other points unlabeled or small 11pt muted label)
chart.bar: for supporting mini-charts (inside satellite boxes on p-06 mirror): width < 0.8in vertical bars or mini-lines, no axes, shape only. 2D vertical bars for full charts: gap:bar 1.5:1, radius 0-2px, 4-color brand fills + optional amber #FFD966. No 3D, no rainbow.
chart.axis: x-axis 0.75pt #A5A5A5 (or hidden); y-axis hidden or minimal; x-axis labels in 10pt #A5A5A5 only
chart.gridline: none — chart border box removed; no grid lines
chart.value_label: Malgun Gothic Bold 22pt panel-color on emphasis point only; 11pt muted gray on comparison points. NEVER tabular monospace.
chart.unit_label: 10-11pt #6B7380 small label at top-right of chart panel; format '(전기비, %)' '(p)' '(억원)'
chart.yellow_callout_above_peak: small #FFFF00 rectangle with 12pt Bold black text (e.g. '5년 만에 최고') sits above the peak of panel 3 chart — serves as the chart slide's yellow signature when header lacks one
chart.legend: none — direct labeling at line peak or data point
chart.types_allowed: 3-panel single-line (SIGNATURE) / 2D vertical bar (supporting) / mini-line or mini-column inside satellite boxes (decorative, width <0.8in)
chart.types_forbidden: pair-chart (left bar + right line 6:6 split), 100% stacked horizontal bar, donut, pie, 3D, gradient fill on bars, rainbow series, dual axis, tabular monospace labels, equation-of-time, scatter, bubble
chart.source_position: inside the chart module as small gray text if needed; NEVER in footer bar

diagram.language: rounded color-filled pill headers (radius 24px) in 4 brand colors + content boxes (radius 6-10px) with white fill + 0.5pt hairline border or micro shadow; yellow fluorescent highlight rectangle on header keyword (MANDATORY per body page, exception slide 4 p-04 mirror and slide 5 p-05 mirror where yellow appears in body callouts instead); central giant circles/diamonds for conceptual diagrams; horizontal gradient arrow ribbons for timelines; 5-tier vertical gradient band stacks for diplomacy/security pages; tilted handwritten memo overlay for narrative one-off
diagram.kit_a_arrow_ribbon_milestones: horizontal arrow shape (width 90% slide, height ~16%), fill linear-gradient navy #425C8C → teal #20988F → cyan #04AFE3 left-to-right (angle 90, stops 0/50/100), arrowhead at end; 6 drop-pin icon containers at x centers [10, 24, 40, 56, 70, 86]% above the ribbon (fill #E0E5EB, dark line-art glyph inside, tip touches ribbon); month label 16pt Bold white above each pin; 2-line callout INSIDE ribbon per pin (line 1 on yellow fluorescent rect 14pt Bold black on 3 of 6, line 2 white bold 16pt). Mirrors p-04. Variation: vertical 5-tier policy banner stack on slide 8 (each tier a different brand pill).
diagram.kit_b_central_giant_circle_dual: two giant circles in central horizontal band, diameter ~28% slide width, slightly adjacent or overlapping. Left = sky #1F91DF solid with '기회' Black 56pt white (x center 36%, y center 50%). Right = deep blue #283473 solid with '도전' Black 56pt white (x center 62%, y center 50%). 3 satellite boxes radiate from each circle (white fill + 0.5pt #D1D5DB border + optional mini chart icon). Bottom auxiliary callout below 기회 circle. Mirrors p-06.
diagram.kit_c_central_diamond_quadrants: single diamond (45deg rotated square) at slide center, fill deep navy #1A223F, w ≈ 22%, h ≈ 30%, with 3-line slogan in white Bold 16pt (text in non-rotated text box overlaid). 4 quadrant rectangles orbit: TOP wide (royal #4472C4 pill), RIGHT tall (purple #564C92 pill), BOTTOM wide (royal pill), LEFT tall (royal pill). Mirrors p-18 (조달청).
diagram.kit_d_color_fill_box_module: pill header (radius 24px, 4-color brand fill, white bold 20pt) + small yellow/amber category badge to the LEFT or top-left ('국정과제 N' / '2026 업무추진방향:' / '1월중, 관계부처 합동') + content box (white fill, radius 6-10px, 0.5pt hairline or micro shadow) with body paragraph and inline yellow fluorescent keyword highlight. Arranged in 2-column / 2x2 / 2x3 / 3-column / 2-col-plus-bottom-band grids. Mirrors p-09 (slide 7) and p-11/p-13 patterns. THE workhorse module of body pages.
diagram.kit_e_3panel_single_line_chart: see chart.signature — 3 equal-width panels (widths 31% each, gap 2.5%) with pill header + bracketed topic label + monochrome line (sky/green/purple) + emphasis point with big bold panel-color value + 2-line takeaway. Mirrors p-05.
diagram.kit_f_five_tier_band_stack: 5 horizontal bands stacked vertically (each h ≈ 13%, y start 18%). Each band = left 30% colored label section (vertical gradient sequence top-to-bottom: royal #4987BF → purple #5464A6 → teal #20988F → cyan #28A4CA → lighter cyan #04AFE3) + right 70% white content section with bullets. Tier label white Bold 18pt inside colored band. Header has TWO yellow keywords (e.g. '전략투자' + '경제안보'). Mirrors p-12.
diagram.kit_g_handwritten_memo_overlay: ONE-OFF creative motif — used only on slide 9 narrative. Header subthesis: ''26년을 "한국경제 [大] 도약 원년"으로' with '大' at 36pt yellow fluorescent echo of cover signature. Central tilted (-8deg) cream paper (#FCFCF6, w ≈ 35%, h ≈ 55%) + soft drop shadow + red+black marker-style handwritten content. 6 small numbered circular badges (diameter ~8%, fan arrangement 3 left + 3 right) in colors [sky, teal, purple, royal, sky, purple] each labeled with one of the 6 policy axes (01 경제활력 / 02 잠재성장률 / 03 민생안정 / 04 전략적 글로벌 / 05 적극적 국부 / 06 재정·세제·공공 혁신). Hairline gray dotted connectors from badge to memo. Mirrors p-07.
diagram.yellow_highlight_signature: MANDATORY on every body page header — colon ':' after main title, then 1-3 Korean character keyword on #FFFF00 rectangle background with black text. Can be TWO keywords on the same header (p-09 / p-12 mirror). Pack identity rule. Exception slides: slide 4 (p-04 mirror) and slide 5 (p-05 mirror) carry the yellow signature in body callouts/chart-callout instead of header.
diagram.render: SVG precise — no div blocks, no rounded-corner suppression, micro shadows OK on content boxes only, gradients allowed only on arrow ribbons, p-12 tier label vertical sequence, and (cinematic) background radial spotlights

slide.transition: instant cut or soft fade 150-200ms. No object animation, no bounce, no zoom, no rotation. Cinematic feel comes from static radial spotlights and fluorescent markers, not motion.

pages.label: 표지 (大 96pt 노란 형광 + 우상귀 cyan arc)
목차 (좌 큰 '목 차' + 우 4 부처 리스트 sky→purple gradient bullets)
섹션 표지 Ⅰ. (2줄 센터 정렬 + 라디얼 스포트라이트)
정책 마일스톤 (6 드롭핀 + 가로 그라데이션 화살표 + 3 노란 콜아웃)
3패널 단일 라인 차트 (sky/green/purple + 헤드라인 컬러 수치 + 우 패널 노란 callout)
쌍 거대 원 SWOT (좌 sky 기회 + 우 deep-blue 도전 + 좌우 3 위성 박스)
2-column + 하단 horizontal band (sky+teal pills + 4 액션 박스, 헤더 노란 2개)
손글씨 메모 오버레이 (-8deg 크림 메모 + 6 numbered 배지 부채꼴, subthesis 大 노란 echo)
검정 마무리 (大 60pt 노란 형광 echo + 감사합니다)
